name: Cecily Sunspire

goals.text: wed my heir into a great house

voice: just, craven lord of House Sunspire; speaks like a proud noble
backstory: Offered her daughter Edith to Ysolde Ironreach and then to Cecily Stormhold, and was refused by both. Rules by the old laws and avoids the field. Her people still sing of the old massacre in the marches and wait for her to answer it.
